mapper.update: UPDATE eb_store_order original_order INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext ext ON ext.order_id = original_order.order_id SET original_order.is_del = 1, original_order.is_system_del = 1, original_order.update_time = NOW() WHERE original_order.order_id = #{orderNo} AND (original_order.paid = 0 OR original_order.paid IS NULL) AND original_order.is_del = 0 AND original_order.is_system_del = 0 AND ext.current_stage = 'WAIT_PAY' AND ext.reservation_expire_time < NOW() AND ext.reservation_released = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM eb_store_order original_order INNER JOIN eb_flower_order_ext ext ON ext.order_id = original_order.order_id WHERE original_order.order_id = #{orderNo} AND (original_order.paid = 0 OR original_order.paid IS NULL) AND original_order.is_del = 1 AND original_order.is_system_del = 1 AND ext.current_stage = 'WAIT_PAY' AND ext.reservation_expire_time < NOW() AND ext.reservation_released = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE eb_store_order SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderNo} AND paid = 1 AND is_del = 0 AND is_system_del = 0 AND status = 1
UPDATE eb_store_order SET refund_status = 2, refund_price = #{refundPrice}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND paid = 1 AND is_del = 0 AND is_system_del = 0 AND refund_status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE eb_store_order SET refund_status = 0, refund_reason = #{reason}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND refund_status = 1

UPDATE eb_store_order SET refund_status = 1, refund_reason_time = #{order.refundReasonTime}, refund_reason_wap = #{order.refundReasonWap}, refund_reason_wap_explain = #{order.refundReasonWapExplain}, refund_reason_wap_img = #{order.refundReasonWapImg}, refund_price = #{order.refundPrice}, update_time = #{order.updateTime} WHERE id = #{order.id} AND refund_status = 0

select * from eb_store_order where uid = #{uid}
and `status` = 0 and `paid` = 0 and `refund_status` = 0 and `type` = 0

and (order_id like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%') or order_id in (select order_no from eb_store_order_info where product_name like CONCAT('%',#{keywords},'%')))
order by id desc
